description: Fix share page deep link for Android (use intent:// scheme), add notification icon config to app.json, and add CSS scroll-snap gallery for multi-media posts on share page
steps: In backend/src/modules/share/share.routes.js, in the GET /p/:postId handler, change the Android deep link strategy. Currently uses an iframe with artnepalaya:// scheme and a setTimeout fallback. Replace with Android Intent URI: intent://p/{postId}#Intent;scheme=artnepalaya;package=com.artnepalaya.mobile;end. Update the 'Open in App' button href for Android to use this intent URI. Update the JavaScript section: for Android, instead of creating an iframe, navigate directly to the intent URI using window.location.href. Remove the iframe-based approach for Android. Keep iframe approach for iOS since intent:// is Android-only.

In mobile/app.json, inside the 'android' object (after adaptiveIcon), add a 'notifications' section: { "icon": "./assets/notification-icon.png", "color": "#FF3B30" }. Since notification-icon.png does not exist yet, copy the existing adaptive-icon.png to notification-icon.png as a placeholder.

In backend/src/modules/share/share.routes.js, replace the single artwork-preview div with a CSS scroll-snap gallery for posts with multiple media items. Add gallery CSS styles: container with overflow-x: auto, scroll-snap-type: x mandatory, -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch. Each media item gets scroll-snap-align: start and min-width: 100%. Add dot indicators below the gallery. For single-media posts, keep the existing simple layout. The gallery should support mixed image/video items. Generate the gallery HTML by iterating over all mediaItems, rendering each as either an img or video element.
acceptance_criteria: Android deep link JavaScript uses window.location.href with intent URI instead of hidden iframe
iOS still uses iframe-based deep link approach
app.json android section includes notifications config with icon and color
notification-icon.png asset file exists (copied from adaptive-icon.png)
Share page renders a horizontal scroll-snap gallery for multi-media posts
Gallery has dot indicators and supports both image and video items
Single-media posts still render without the gallery wrapper
findings: All three changes implemented: (1) Android intent:// URI replaces iframe-based deep link for more reliable app opening - the intent system handles fallback to Play Store natively; (2) notification icon config added to app.json android section with adaptive-icon.png copied as placeholder; (3) CSS scroll-snap gallery renders all media items horizontally with dot indicators and badge counter, while single-media posts retain simple layout. Syntax validation passed (node --check). Code reviewed, runtime not tested.
